question: What is the name of the large-scale demographic survey conducted to provide reliable estimates of birth and death rates and other fertility and mortality indicators at the national and sub-national levels?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sample Registration System (SRS)**__

• **Sample Registration System (SRS)** is a large-scale demographic survey conducted in India.
 
• It provides reliable estimates of birth and death rates, as well as other fertility and mortality indicators.
